policy: No adapter is enabled until immutable revision, license, provenance, weight-load, inference and benchmark evidence are present in the official repository.

VERIFY_REQUIRED: silent input produced a Korean-mode generation result; it cannot establish Korean transcription accuracy or timestamps.

blocker: SAM and LaMa have live five-fixture functional benchmarks but require human quality review.
